# Onda for Mac 1.1.0 beta 125 — Lighter everyday listening
- Reduce repeated audio-device reads and unnecessary settings writes during everyday listening. - Share audio observations within each polling cycle while keeping call, video and device-recovery checks fresh. - Keep your speaker choices, volume, balance, timing, tuning and automatic call/video switching when updating.
This universal Mac beta supports Apple silicon and Intel. It is Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. The audio driver remains 1.0.5 build 6; no driver update is needed. Automatic updates install when you quit Onda.
Validation: 355 Swift tests, including 350 passes and five existing fixture-dependent skips; no failures. Fable reviewed the efficiency changes and cleared installation after a recovery-cache issue was repaired. Live muted Google Meet and native video tests confirmed display-only playback and automatic Spotify/Office return with the same volume and balance. Rollside playback was not separately verified in this release.
The iPhone app and its App Store submission are unchanged.
